name: @forgewallet/protocol-swap2-chainflip
description: Chainflip vault swaps: native BTC / ETH / SOL / TRX and USDC / USDT across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Solana, Tron and Bitcoin via Chainflip's public backend (0 bps, no account).
